compiled_receiver_clearance.method: Cylinders use mj_geomDistance with collision masks bypassed. Box/box pairs use the separating-axis lower bound from actual compiled geom transforms and sizes, because the MuJoCo3.3.7 distance dispatcher can return zero for separated boxes. Keeper, shoulder and mounting bracket versus every door contact geom; initial opening sampled at 1 mrad and full door travel at 50 mrad. A probe placed inside the keeper must return negative distance.

scope: Two existing fixture tasks over three seeds and paired no-action controls; state interlocks and a small-probe/ray audit of the compiled pocket. These do not constitute general robot-policy or calibrated latch-force validation.
